rules.statement: The delivery of an award to the parties is mandatory.
rules.supporting_quote: The delivery of the award to the parties is mandatory. However, in the circumstances the appellant had adduced sufficient evidence of compliance with section 25(4) as to the delivery of the award to the respondent. Hence the High Court should take action in terms of section 31(6) of the Act. 221
